name: cloudy-ai-embeddings-api
description: Fleet embeddings + rerank + PDF text server, CPU, mesh-only on oci-apps. OpenAI-compatible POST /embeddings (BAAI/bge-m3) and POST /rerank (BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3) served by Infinity, plus POST /pdf (raw application/pdf body to plain text, pypdf), GET /models and GET /health. Consumers: Cloud SuperIntel Notebook retrieval and Cloud Tools Retrieval steps. Mesh address http://embeddings-api.mesh.diegonmarcos.com:7997 (direct, plain HTTP inside WireGuard); no public route.

agent._comment: Explicit opt-OUT, required by 9_others/test/test_agent_git_tree_declared.sh in cloud-infra. embeddings-api is a stateless model server (embeddings, rerank, pdf-to-text over HTTP); it never reads or commits a repository, so the shared tree would widen its blast radius for nothing.

runtime._doc: The container (host network) listens on 7997 on oci-apps' WireGuard address only (never 0.0.0.0): the mesh direct-dial rule (#1104), Hickory row embeddings-api -> 10.0.0.6 in infra-net_hickory-dns/build.json.

models._doc: Downloaded from Hugging Face on first start into the embeddings_api_hf volume (about 4.6 GB for both, fp32 on CPU; resident about 5 GB, hence mem_limit 6G). gate.py answers /health at once (liveness) and /ready only once both are loaded; until then every other path is 503.

monitoring._doc: Mesh-only plain HTTP on a direct-dial port, like c3-infra-api: no TLS and no hub route to probe.

unit.cmd: python3 -m pip install -q pypdf==5.1.0 fastapi==0.115.6 && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s test

api.description: OpenAI-compatible embeddings, rerank, PDF to text; mesh-only, no auth (WireGuard is the gate).

legacy_aliases._doc: API rebrand #1450: the old names stay served for one release (DNS alias, Caddy path rewrite from _rebrand-1450/caddy-legacy-redirects.caddy, old image tag). Remove after the alias release.

_gateway: Reached publicly only through cloudy-ai-api at /ai/<name> (old /<name>-api path is a gateway legacy route).
